evidence_scope: Previously captured public initial HTML. Source claims are not independently measured performance. No new requests, storefront writes or live publication.

drafts.title: How the AM Infinity .97 battery swap system works
drafts.summary: The AM Infinity .97 uses a hot-swappable magnetic battery system. Keep one battery in the mouse while the spare charges on the receiver, then swap in the charged spare when needed.

sections.heading: Two batteries, two roles
sections.body: The captured product page lists two batteries and a receiver with battery charging. One battery powers the mouse; the receiver charges the spare.

sections.heading: What the swap changes
sections.body: Swapping installs a battery that has already been charged. It does not recharge the battery inside the mouse during the swap. This system keeps a charged spare available for repeated use.

sections.heading: Understanding battery life
sections.body: A single battery still needs recharging. Battery life depends on settings and use. This revision provides no charging-time, reconnection-time or runtime guarantee.

sections.heading: Instructions and support
sections.body: Use the official model-specific manual for operation. Storefront customers can use the existing support address for product questions.

drafts.title: AM Infinity .97 换电机制与续航说明
drafts.summary: AM Infinity .97 采用磁吸可更换电池设计。一块电池为鼠标供电，另一块电池放在接收器上充电；需要换电时，装入已充好电的备用电池。

sections.heading: 两块电池分别做什么
sections.body: 本次抓取的产品页装箱清单列有两块电池，以及支持电池充电的接收器。使用鼠标时，可以让备用电池在接收器上充电。

sections.heading: 换电和充电的区别
sections.body: 换电是把已经充好电的备用电池装入鼠标。备用电池的电量来自此前在接收器上的充电过程，换电动作本身并不会瞬间充满电池。

sections.heading: 怎样理解续航
sections.body: 每块电池的电量仍会消耗，使用后需要再次充电。实际可用时长会受设置和使用方式影响。本稿不提供充电时间、重连时间或续航时长保证。

sections.heading: 操作说明与支持
sections.body: 具体操作以对应型号的官方说明书为准。下方为海外商店现有的官方资料入口；中国大陆购买与售后渠道需使用该市场对应的有效政策。
